description: Hurricane Ian regional infrastructure disruption — real archived Reported 1-hour precipitation, Station wind speed, Station sea-level pressure.
label_definition: Overlap with the documented event interval. Event-window association only.
limitations: Single NOAA station: FORT MYERS PAGE FIELD AIRPORT, FL US (72210612835). It does not measure regional infrastructure damage or flood extent.
Only accepted ISD quality flags are used; missing readings remain null. Precipitation is a reported accumulation, not an inferred flood boundary.
Documented event-window labels are a coarse association target, not independent hour-level operational anomaly ground truth.
A single incident with normal-only pre-event training cannot validate a fitted advance-warning classifier.
Archives may include later revisions. Observation time is not proof of original publication availability; retrospective results do not establish live prediction accuracy.
